initiatives.name: Commercial Healthcare Products Portfolio Realignment
initiatives.summary: A portfolio of commercial healthcare products previously distributed by STM is now managed and distributed entirely within the Risk business area, with associated revenue and profit reallocated accordingly. This reflects an internal restructuring of business segment reporting to better align products with their primary distribution channel.

evidence.title: Reporting Realignment of Commercial Healthcare Products
evidence.summary: A portfolio of commercial healthcare products previously distributed by STM is now managed and distributed entirely within the Risk business area, with associated revenue and profit reallocated accordingly. This reflects an internal restructuring of business segment reporting to better align products with their primary distribution channel.
evidence.quote: Also, a small portfolio of commercial healthcare products, previously distributed by Scientific, Technical & Medical (STM), is now managed and distributed entirely in Risk.

initiatives.name: Print Business Wind-Down
initiatives.summary: RELX is proactively reducing its involvement in print and print-related activities through outsourcing, joint ventures, and targeted asset disposals, while still making print content available to customers who prefer it. This has been stepped up over the past two years and resulted in a significant revenue decline in this segment, now reported separately from core business areas.

evidence.title: Print and Print-Related Business Wind-Down

This has been stepped up over the past two years and resulted in a significant revenue decline in this segment, now reported separately from core business areas.
evidence.quote: Over the past two years, we have stepped up our efforts to do this through out-sourcing, joint ventures and targeted asset disposals. Consistent with this, we are now managing and reporting print and print-related activities separately.

initiatives.name: Board Composition Refresh
initiatives.summary: Robert MacLeod retired from the Board after serving since 2016, and Andy Halford, former CFO of Vodafone and Standard Chartered, was appointed as a Non-Executive Director. Alistair Cox succeeded Robert MacLeod as Chair of the Remuneration Committee.

evidence.title: Board Changes: New Non-Executive Director Appointed
evidence.summary: Robert MacLeod retired from the Board after serving since 2016, and Andy Halford, former CFO of Vodafone and Standard Chartered, was appointed as a Non-Executive Director. Alistair Cox succeeded Robert MacLeod as Chair of the Remuneration Committee.
evidence.quote: At the 2025 Annual General Meeting (AGM), Robert MacLeod, who had been on the Board since 2016, retired and Andy Halford was appointed a Non-Executive Director.

initiatives.name: Product Development Capital Investment
initiatives.summary: RELX increased capital expenditure to £525 million in 2025 (5.5% of revenue), up from £484 million in 2024, with the majority (£504 million) spent on capitalised development costs reflecting sustained investment in new products and technology.

initiatives.name: Share Buyback Programme Expansion
initiatives.summary: Following £1,500 million deployed on share buybacks in 2025, RELX intends to deploy a total of £2,250 million on share buybacks in 2026, reflecting confidence in the company's financial position and cash flow generation. This is a capital allocation/shareholder returns signal rather than a strategic transformation initiative, but demonstrates financial strategy commitment.

evidence.title: Increased Share Buyback Programme for 2026

This is a capital allocation/shareholder returns signal rather than a strategic transformation initiative, but demonstrates financial strategy commitment.
evidence.quote: We deployed £1,500m on share buybacks in 2025. In recognition of our strong financial position and cash flow we intend to deploy a total of £2,250m on share buybacks in 2026, of which £250m has already been completed.

initiatives.name: UK Fraud Prevention Framework Enhancement
initiatives.summary: RELX enhanced its fraud prevention processes and procedures in preparation for the UK's new 'Failure to Prevent Fraud' offence applicable from 1 September 2025, updating its Framework for mitigating fraud risk and maintaining compliance.

evidence.title: Fraud Prevention Framework Enhanced for New UK Offence

initiatives.name: Net Zero by 2040 Transition Plan
initiatives.summary: RELX has committed to achieving net zero emissions by 2040 at the latest, covering both its own operations (Scope 1+2) and supply chain (Scope 3). The company has already achieved an 87% reduction in Scope 1 and Scope 2 (location-based) carbon emissions since 2010 through actions including office footprint reduction, cloud migration, EV fleet transition, and renewable energy purchases.
